signals.text: Exac What I was looking for
I like the color and fabric "feel".  Washed well.  It is a tighter fit than others I've bought that are the same size.  It is a "slim" fit.

It's nice having so many places to hold cards. Credit cards fit, but most business cards have to be shoved in and may look a bit mangled. Medicare cards must be put into a larger pocket. American money is a tight fit also. It is nice to have a wallet and multi card holder that is longer and therefore stays fairly slim.
